```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: false
# Funciones auxiliares para mostrar resultados sin código
fmt <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "< 0.0001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4))
fmt_peq <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "< 0.0001", paste("=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)))
fmt_ic <- function(x, d = 3) ifelse(is.infinite(x), ifelse(x > 0, "+∞", "−∞"), fmt(x, d))
tabla_contraste <- function(res, estadistico = names(res$statistic), gl = TRUE, d = 3) {
  est <- if (is.null(res$statistic)) "—" else paste0(estadistico, " = ", fmt(res$statistic, 3))
  g <- if (!gl || is.null(res$parameter)) "—" else
    paste(ifelse(res$parameter == round(res$parameter), fmt(res$parameter, 0), fmt(res$parameter, 2)), collapse = " y ")
  ic <- if (is.null(res$conf.int)) "—" else paste0("[", fmt_ic(res$conf.int[1], d), ", ", fmt_ic(res$conf.int[2], d), "]")
  kable(tibble(Estadístico = est, `Grados de libertad` = g, `p-valor` = fmt_p(res$p.value),
               `Intervalo de confianza` = ic), align = "c")
}
```
